name: Glycine

typical_dose_shape.note: No FDA-approved dosing reference exists for this compound. This range describes reported use and is not a recommendation.

description: The simplest amino acid, an inhibitory neurotransmitter at the glycine receptor and a constituent of glutathione and collagen. Taken before sleep for its reported effect on sleep onset and core temperature.

systems.note: Glycine receptor activity and reported effect on sleep onset; the intended effect.
A constituent amino acid of glutathione, often taken with cysteine for that purpose.

monitors.why: The accessible instrument for the sleep and affective effect claimed.
